questions.question: Which article of the Indian Constitution deals with the Panchayati Raj system?
questions.explanation: Article 243 deals with the Panchayati Raj system.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a fundamental right in the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: The Right to Property is not a fundamental right in the Indian Constitution.

questions.question: The Sixth Schedule of the Indian Constitution applies to which states?
options: Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana
Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, West Bengal, Bihar
Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Punjab, Haryana, Chandigarh
questions.explanation: The Sixth Schedule applies to Assam, Meghalaya, Manipur, Tripura, and Mizoram.

questions.question: What is the term for the power given to the Governor of a state to reserve certain posts for Scheduled Castes?
questions.explanation: The Power to Reserve is the term for the power given to the Governor.

questions.question: Which provision of the Indian Constitution ensures the representation of Anglo-Indian community in the Lok Sabha?
questions.explanation: Article 330 ensures the representation of Anglo-Indian community in the Lok Sabha.

questions.question: Which famous Bengali revolutionary founded the Indian Home Rule Society in 1916?
questions.explanation: Aurobindo Ghosh founded the Indian Home Rule Society.

questions.question: Which event in Bengal played a significant role in shaping the Indian freedom struggle?
questions.explanation: The Swadeshi Movement in Bengal was a key event.

questions.question: Which act was implemented in Bengal by Lord Curzon in 1905?
questions.explanation: The Bengal Partition Act was implemented by Lord Curzon.

questions.question: Who was the key figure behind the Non-Cooperation Movement in Bengal in 1921?
questions.explanation: C.R. Das was the key figure behind the Non-Cooperation Movement.

questions.question: Which Bengali leader was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 1990 for his contributions to the Indian independence movement?
questions.explanation: Subhas Chandra Bose was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 1990.

questions.question: The Ganges River originates from which mountain in West Bengal?
questions.explanation: The Ganges River originates from the glaciers of Mount Kanchenjunga.

questions.question: Which of the following is a major delta of West Bengal?
questions.explanation: The Ganges-Brahmaputra Delta is a major delta of West Bengal.

questions.question: What is the major landform type of Sundarbans?
questions.explanation: The Sundarbans is a delta.

questions.question: Which river flows through the Darjeeling district in West Bengal?
questions.explanation: The Tista River flows through the Darjeeling district.

questions.question: Which of the following mountain ranges is located in the northern part of West Bengal?
questions.explanation: The Himalayas mountain range is located in the northern part of West Bengal.

questions.question: Which of the following West Bengal government schemes aims to provide financial assistance to the families of police personnel killed in the line of duty?
questions.explanation: Bhagya Shree Scheme is a West Bengal government scheme to support families of police personnel killed.

questions.question: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) launched a new satellite for which of the following purpose in 2025?
questions.explanation: The satellite was launched for Earth Observation by ISRO in 2025.

questions.question: Which of the following is the key feature of the new industrial policy of the West Bengal government?
questions.explanation: Single Window Clearance System is a key feature of the new industrial policy of the West Bengal government.

questions.question: The West Bengal government has launched a new initiative to promote tourism in which of the following districts?
questions.explanation: The West Bengal government has launched the new initiative to promote tourism in Howrah District.

questions.question: The West Bengal government has increased the minimum pension under which of the following schemes from?
questions.explanation: The West Bengal government has increased the minimum pension under the pension scheme from Rs. 900 to Rs. 1000.

questions.question: The West Bengal government's Kanyashree Prakalpa scheme aims to
options: Empower girls through education and marriage
Provide financial assistance to pregnant women
Offer skill development training to youth
Provide subsidies to farmers for agricultural inputs
questions.explanation: Empower girls through education and marriage.

questions.question: The Swasthya Sathi Scheme is a health insurance initiative by the West Bengal government, which provides
options: Free healthcare services to all citizens
Subsidized healthcare services to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families
Financial assistance to patients for treatment in private hospitals
Free medical treatment to patients in government hospitals
questions.explanation: Financial assistance to patients for treatment in private hospitals.

questions.question: The Unnayan scheme is a welfare program by the West Bengal government aimed at
options: Providing financial assistance to entrepreneurs for starting new businesses
Offering skill development training to rural youth
Providing scholarships to meritorious students from backward classes
Offering subsidies to farmers for purchasing agricultural equipment
questions.explanation: Providing financial assistance to entrepreneurs for starting new businesses.

questions.question: The West Bengal government's 'Bangla Abas Yojana' aims to
options: Provide financial assistance to families of martyrs
Offer skill development training to youth from backward classes
Provide subsidies to farmers for agricultural inputs
Offer financial assistance to families affected by natural disasters
questions.explanation: Provide financial assistance to families of martyrs.

questions.question: The Madhyamik Shiksha Kendra (MSK) is a government-funded initiative aimed at
options: Providing vocational training to school dropouts
Offering scholarships to meritorious students from rural areas
Providing financial assistance to students for pursuing higher education
Offering free mid-day meals to school children
questions.explanation: Providing vocational training to school dropouts.

questions.question: If the simple interest on a certain sum of money for 2 years at 8% per annum is Rs. 960, then the compound interest on the same sum for 3 years at the same rate is?
questions.explanation: Compound interest is always more than simple interest.

questions.question: What is the difference between compound interest and simple interest on Rs. 10000 for 2 years at 10% per annum?
questions.explanation: Compound interest includes the interest on interest.

questions.question: The simple interest on Rs. 5000 for 4 years at 9% per annum is?
questions.explanation: Interest is always calculated on the principal amount.

questions.question: What is the amount after 2 years on a deposit of Rs. 8000 at 12% per annum compound interest?
questions.explanation: Compound interest is calculated on the current balance.

questions.question: Rahul deposited Rs. 20000 in a bank for 3 years at 6% per annum simple interest. His total amount after 3 years is?
questions.explanation: Simple interest is calculated on the principal amount only.

questions.question: A pipe can fill 1/4th of a 200-meter long tank in 2 hours. How many hours will it take to fill the entire tank?
questions.explanation: Rate of work is constant.

questions.question: A contractor can complete a job in 20 days working alone. He hires another contractor who works at half the rate of the first contractor. How many days will it take for them to complete the job working together?
questions.explanation: Combined work rate is sum of individual work rates.

questions.question: A tap can fill a bucket in 10 minutes. If the tap is closed and the bucket is emptied in 5 minutes, how many more minutes will it take to fill the bucket?
questions.explanation: Net result is bucket being emptied.

questions.question: Two pipes can fill 1/8th and 1/4th of a 150-meter long tank in 4 hours. How many hours will it take to fill the entire tank?
questions.explanation: Rate of work is constant.

questions.question: A pump can empty 1/5th of a 240-meter long tank in 6 hours. How many hours will it take to empty the entire tank?
questions.explanation: Rate of work is constant.

questions.question: A train travels from Howrah to Digha at an average speed of 60 km/h. If the distance between Howrah and Digha is 200 km, then how much time will it take to cover the distance?
questions.explanation: Time = Distance / Speed.

questions.question: What is the ratio of the speeds of two buses if one travels from Kolkata to Siliguri in 4 hours and covers a distance of 250 km, while the other travels from Siliguri to Kolkata in 3 hours and covers the same distance?
questions.explanation: Speed = Distance / Time.

questions.question: A car travels from Kolkata to Durgapur at an average speed of 80 km/h. If the distance between Kolkata and Durgapur is 180 km, then how much time will it take to cover the distance?
questions.explanation: Time = Distance / Speed.

questions.question: What is the average speed of a train if it travels from Sealdah to Bardhaman in 3 hours and covers a distance of 160 km?
questions.explanation: Average Speed = Total Distance / Total Time.

questions.question: A bus travels from Siliguri to Darjeeling at an average speed of 40 km/h. If the distance between Siliguri and Darjeeling is 120 km, then how much time will it take to cover the distance?
questions.explanation: Time = Distance / Speed.

questions.question: If A is the mother of C and B is the sister of C, how is B related to A?
questions.explanation: B is the daughter of A's husband.

questions.question: If P is the brother of Q, how is R related to Q, if R is the father of P?
questions.explanation: R is the grandfather of Q.

questions.question: If X is the sister of Y and Z is the son of Y, how is X related to Z?
questions.explanation: X is the aunt of Z.

questions.question: If A and B are sisters, and C is the son of A's father's brother, then how is C related to B?
questions.explanation: C is the first cousin of B.

questions.question: If R is the father of S and T is the brother of S, then how is T related to R?
questions.explanation: T is the son of R's brother.

questions.question: In the series 2, 5, 8, 11, 14, ? what comes next?
questions.explanation: The pattern is adding 3 to each number.

questions.question: If the pattern for letters A, B, C, D, E continues, the next letter will be?
questions.explanation: The pattern follows the alphabet.

questions.question: In the series 10, 20, 40, 80, 160, ? what comes next?
questions.explanation: The pattern is doubling the previous number.

questions.question: If the pattern for numbers 3, 6, 9, 12, 15 continues, the next number will be?
questions.explanation: The pattern is adding 3 to each number.

questions.question: In the series 1, 8, 27, 64, 125, ? what comes next?
questions.explanation: The pattern is cubing the numbers.
